name: satyalens-synthetic-financial-messages
source: Hand-written templates in scripts/generate_synthetic_dataset.py, slot-filled with fictional values. No real messages or personal data.
licence: Created for this project; no third-party data. Distributed under the repository's licence (pyproject.toml declares MIT).

label_definitions.suspicious: Template written to exhibit a known financial social-engineering pattern.
label_definitions.legitimate: Template written to resemble routine financial communication.

intended_use: Pipeline development and functional testing ONLY.
limitations: Synthetic, template-generated text; vocabulary and style are narrow and author-biased.
Labels reflect the template author's intent, not verified real-world outcomes.
Metrics on this data do NOT indicate real-world scam-detection performance.
English and a little romanised Hindi only.
